title: KCITA Program
author: Jimmy  G.
desc: The 8-Week Chemo Training Program is designed specifically for individuals looking to regain strength and vitality during and after chemotherapy. With a balanced approach of two workouts per week, this program focuses on gentle yet effective exercises that promote recovery and enhance overall well-being. Each session is crafted to build endurance, improve mobility, and boost confidence, helping you to navigate your fitness journey with resilience. Commit to these 8 weeks and take a powerful step towards reclaiming your health.

ex.note: Progress to unassisted bodyweight squat once chair push-off is no longer needed (~Week 4-5).
Lower the incline (wall -> counter -> bench) as reps become easy, not before.
Increase band tension/weight only when top of rep range is easy at RPE ~5.
Keep load light; this is a grip/core/postural drill, not a strength test.
Low-intensity, used to close the session and support recovery.
Use a low step; watch footing closely if peripheral neuropathy is present.
Keep hand support nearby at all times; progress range of motion before adding load.
Skip or regress to a partial range if a port/central line limits overhead motion.
No spinal loading; prioritize slow, controlled reps over speed.
Low-impact conditioning to close the session.
